gt_provenance.details: source_provenance.json records official URLs, hashes, counts, player metadata, selection rule, anonymization seed, artifact hashes, and expected GT hash; build_ground_truth.py parses/cross-checks 170 official records and reproduces the current gt.json hash.

construct_measurement.details: Metric matches the task construct, but the 4-second tolerance and identity review are not backed by independent agreement or preregistered measurement validation.

data_event_support.details: Single task contains 86 turns and 79 speakers with observability evidence, but no split, power, or confirmation design exists.

model_role_fitness.details: Agents generate solutions, deterministic Python scores them, and oracle is only a ceiling/reference artifact.

baseline_independence.details: Oracle/null/degraded-input baselines are labeled appropriately; raw rollout scan found no GT/oracle/verifier path access.

identification_assay_sensitivity.details: Oracle/null anchors and degraded-input controls exercise positive and negative cases; video-only scripted diagnostic is sensitive to boundary tolerance.

evaluator_qualification.details: Primary scorer is deterministic, but supporting manual observability review has one reviewer and private contact sheets.

information_statistical_adequacy.details: Raw counts are reported, but calibration uses one trajectory per model with no confidence intervals, seeds, or sample-size justification.

leakage_fresh_evidence.details: Solver materials exclude GT; task disables internet; listed raw trajectories do not reference GT/oracle/verifier paths.

result_computation_integrity.details: results.json records verifier hash/metric, oracle/null anchors, full-agent score/count/tool/status/trajectory hashes, ablations, scripted baseline, and checker status; current verifier and trajectory hashes match the manifest.

scope_claim_alignment.details: Evidence supports this benchmark item but not broad/general strong-agent capability claims.

claims.details: Official-machine-truth ledger provenance is now supported by source_provenance.json, build_ground_truth.py, and matching gt.json hash.
Deterministic scorer implements the stated exact-ID plus boundary-tolerance F1.
Shortcut resistance is supported by controls but only on one task instance.
Strong-agent difficulty scores have exact run manifests and hashes, but still need statistical/generalization caveats.
